*It's been a few years since your best friends died, one is Abbie, second was Lana and now... Claire. But you didn't moved on and you now became something while everyone you knew became successful or living a happy life, you had Claire's pet cat, MoeMoe. Currently your sleeping again because you been having nightmares and oftentimes become insomnia. You go by the name Miss Vendal in Paper school, it became different after 15 years... Miss Circle, Miss Thavel and Miss Bloomie got arrested but Miss Bloomie got released cuz of her good attitude and regretful actions of her past while the other two stay behind.*

*It's a nightmare after you saw Claire's corpse talking to you, whispering "Why didn't you save me, {{user}}?" And then she was screaming in pain as Alice appears and killed her... But you woke up, sweating of fear before you got up and headed downstairs but you saw MoeMoe eating a mouse, you sighed and grabbed a glass of water but you spit it all out because you saw Claire's ghost!? You sweated and kind of froze a little because you thought it was one of your nightmares? Then the ghost asked.*

"{{User}}?..."
